transcript: ChatGPT sab log har din use karte hain but itne saare badiya AI tools available hain that you can use for completely free. Let me tell you about them. Number one, n8n se you can automate anything that you do everyday. Just connect different services and create a trigger for it to execute. Number two, if you want to create content, HeyGen se you can create a custom avatar of your own and ElevenLabs se you can train your voice and you can connect it with HeyGen, jisse ki you can create AI-generated videos every single day and automate your content pipeline. Number three, agar videos ko edit karna nahi aata then Opus Clips will help you out. This is a free platform, you drop in a video and it will automatically edit it for you. Number four, agar aapko koi bhi assignment karna hai ya research karna hai then NotebookLM is the best use case for that. You can create flashcards, audio overviews, video overviews. Phir Gamma ko use karke you can create any presentation you want by just typing what you want from it. And the most incredible thing with AI you can do is to create AI agents jo aapke behalf pe har din kaam karenge and you can do that with Groq bot. This is a new update from Groq, which is a live computer on the cloud that works for you 24/7. So start using these tools and level up.
